notes.title: Holiday update and future chapters
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
I wanted to apologize for the delays of Chapters 4 and 5 and ask for your patience as I polish them up before release. As you might expect, this has been a busy time of year in my personal life (holiday happenings, a new nephew, and more than a little seasonal anxiety around the one-year anniversary of my lymphoma diagnosis) and things have taken longer than planned. I'm sure it's been frustrating for everyone awaiting the next part of the story, so I am truly sorry.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33120697/48339b5f3c0e82e84cd6c4d53948d3746f439acf.png[/img]

I think once you get to play these next couple chapters you'll understand why they've been such a hurtle for me. Not only are we approaching the emotional apex of Lyric's story, but as the game goes on, more and more of your personal choices will branch off and offer different outcomes... which of course adds to the development time of even the simplest scenes. I sincerely hope the full story is as meaningful and satisfying as everyone is expecting and certainly don't want to rush to the finish line.

So! I am pushing back Chapters 4 and 5 once again, and this time I won't make the mistake of promising a release date. It will most likely be early January and sincerely hope the wait will be worth it. This community means so much to be and I don't want to let you down.

More updates to come very soon! 
Happy holidays to all!

All my best,
David Grund
[url]waywardprophet.com[/url]

notes.title: Patch notes plus a new release schedule
notes.notes:
Hello all!
I've been hard at work on A Story Beside since release, both on the development of new chapters and assorted bug-fixes that have inevitably popped up during this Early Access period. I truly appreciate everyone who has been so patient and so diligent in reporting any and all issues you've come across.

A new update is now available that contains several new features and should solve many of the bugs in the first few chapters. Please take a look at the patch notes below and be sure to post in the discussion forum if problems continue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33696968/9423e9cdeb344e95bd77ec1454e67821b104d410.png[/img]

[h1]Updates:[/h1][list][*] Brand new menu system (should fix all menu-related bugs)
[*] Fixed bug that would trap players in certain maps after saving
[*] Fixed bug that would report incorrect player choices
[*] Fixed data bug when replaying earlier chapters
[*] Fixed item inventory
[*] Increased number of save slots (from 4 to 10)
[*] Save points added at the end of each chapter
[*] New (optional) scene with Kelsi
[*] New dialogue added at a few different points to clarify choices
[*] Additional hints at designated story points
[/list]
[h1]Outstanding Issues:[/h1][list][*] Some players are able to walk over anything on the map
[*] Error popup while saving (although the game should still save) 
[*] Missing save files
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33696968/aeacfeb3a5d85357d8746cdb9b0ae04c12aba862.png[/img]

In addition, I've updated the release schedule for future chapters to reflect these new updates and developments going forward. It's possible I won't be always be able to hit these exact dates, and I appreciate your patience if that ends up being the case. I'm doing my best to release new content regularly, but as a solo developer during a very busy time of year, I can't always pin things down 100%.

Thank you all so much 😊 I hope you're enjoying A Story Beside so far!

All my best,
David Grund
